meta.name: Mailglass Brand Tokens
meta.notes: Source-control-friendly brand, docs, collateral, and lightweight example tokens. Raw palette tokens are source values; semantic roles are usage values for background, surface, border, text, link, focus, state, callout, and code. Product admin UI remains governed by mailglass_admin/docs/design-system.md and its Tailwind/daisyUI token layers; any future product mapping must be deliberate, and brandbook/tokens.css is not a second admin UI framework.

ink.description: Raw palette source value for primary text, dark surfaces, and code-adjacent structure

glass.description: Raw palette source value for the restrained brand accent, links, focus, and selected states; not a default border or background flood

ice.description: Raw palette source value for bright supporting accent and dark-surface highlight

mist.description: Raw palette source value for subtle surfaces and quiet panes

paper.description: Raw palette source value for primary light background

slate.description: Raw palette source value for secondary text, metadata, and subdued structure

amber.description: Raw palette source value for warning and caution states

crimson.description: Raw palette source value for error and destructive states

pine.description: Raw palette source value for success and healthy states

inkRaised.description: Raw palette source value for dark elevated surface

inkPressed.description: Raw palette source value for dark pressed or active surface

pineDark.description: Raw palette source value for success on dark surfaces

amberDark.description: Raw palette source value for warning on dark surfaces

crimsonDark.description: Raw palette source value for error on dark surfaces

default.description: Semantic state role for default emphasis; pair with text, icon, label, or shape cues

hover.description: Semantic state role for hover emphasis, not decoration

active.description: Semantic state role for active or pressed affordances

focus.description: Semantic state role for visible focus structure

disabled.description: Semantic state role for disabled UI; include text or affordance changes, not color alone

selected.description: Semantic state role for selected surfaces; pair with border, aria state, or label cues

success.description: Semantic state role for success; pair with explicit text/icon/label cues

warning.description: Semantic state role for warning; pair with explicit text/icon/label cues

error.description: Semantic state role for error; pair with explicit text/icon/label cues

info.description: Semantic state role for information; use as border, icon, or accent unless Phase 84 contrast validation approves a normal body-text pair

subtle.description: Semantic state role for subtle non-text structure and backgrounds

muted.description: Semantic state role for muted text and metadata, subject to context contrast

infoBackground.description: Callout background role for information surfaces; treat the info pair as background, border, and non-text structure until Phase 84 contrast validation approves body text usage

infoBorder.description: Callout border or icon role for information; do not use as normal body text on infoBackground before Phase 84 validation

successBackground.description: Callout background role for success surfaces

successBorder.description: Callout border or icon role for success; pair with explicit success text

warningBackground.description: Callout background role for warning surfaces

warningBorder.description: Callout border or icon role for warning; pair with explicit warning text

errorBackground.description: Callout background role for error surfaces

errorBorder.description: Callout border or icon role for error; pair with explicit error text

mono.value: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
